installed_version_note: The Codex CLI binary on the build machine fails to start (missing vendored executable). No version could be observed and no live check was possible.

skills_discovery.format: Agent Skills (SKILL.md with name and description)
skills_discovery.implicit_invocation: by description; policy.allow_implicit_invocation may disable it

dispatch.mechanism: subagents feature ([agents] enabled, default true); the root session asks for an agent by name or applicable instructions request delegation
dispatch.nesting_control: not documented; the adapter keeps dispatch flat by instruction only

receipt_observability.child_identity: unobserved: documentation shows spawned threads in a Subagents list and /subagents in the CLI but does not state that a thread id is returned to the parent; recorded as unknown until a conformance run shows otherwise
receipt_observability.usage_and_cost: not exposed to the controller; recorded as unknown

tool_restrictions.mechanism: none for sandbox or approvals; capability reduction only through features.* = false

proposal-only.instruction: state the write scope in developer_instructions

assigned-worktree.instruction: state the authorized paths in developer_instructions

tool_restrictions.note: Disabling shell_tool for proposal-only roles removes file reading through the shell as well; the adapter emits it only when the policy file enables it (default off), so by default roles rely on instructions and the parent sandbox.

permission_behavior.isolation_note: Official documentation: a custom agent file cannot replace the parent's sandbox or approval policy, and instructions asking an agent to avoid edits do not create a separate read-only sandbox. The adapter therefore never presents a role as isolated on this host.

human_input_attestation: not available to the controller; approvals recorded through the CLI are unattested
validation_command: python3 install.py --target <scratch-dir> --host codex, then in Codex run /subagents (blocked on the build machine)
blocked_reason: Codex CLI binary missing on the build machine; reinstall required before any live validation.
notes: Generated from documentation only. A third-party article claims sandbox_mode can be lowered per agent; the official page says it cannot. The adapter follows the official page and the conformance run records what the installed version actually does.
